title: Corner Detection
oneLine: Find points where intensity changes in every direction.

paras: Corners are the most distinctive local features - unlike a smooth region or a straight edge, a corner shifts in appearance whichever way you move. The Harris detector measures this with the structure tensor of local gradients; large change in two directions means a corner worth tracking across frames.
The Harris response from the structure tensor M:
sections.texNote: Large positive R means two strong gradient directions - a corner.

sections.code:
Ix, Iy = grad(I)
M = [[smooth(Ix*Ix), smooth(Ix*Iy)],
     [smooth(Ix*Iy), smooth(Iy*Iy)]]
R = det(M) - 0.04 * trace(M)**2      # corners where R is large
sections.caption: Two strong gradient directions = a trackable corner.

takeaways: Corners change in all directions - the best local features.
The structure tensor's eigenvalues reveal them.
They anchor tracking, matching, and motion estimation.
